plan.forms: Keep forms at 5 questions or fewer, prefilled, with a work email field and one qualifying question: the number of locations. For the full form review, use linkedin-lead-gen-optimizer.

roadmap.do: Make the approved changes, restart the gym chains campaign, launch the precision campaign, and leave them alone apart from a rejected ad or a broken form.
Rerun this skill: check the clinic groups campaign's leakage with expansion off, pause ads by the section 5 rule, and set the restarted campaign's bid against the suggested range.
Move budget toward the campaigns under $120 per qualified lead, in steps of 20% or less, and test one new audience or offer at a time.

plan.measurement: Weekly: spend, feed clicks, leads and the committee's share of spend. Monthly: cost per qualified lead. Cost per opportunity and pipeline need CRM counts, which weren't given.

unknowns: Lead quality past the form: no CRM counts, so 'qualified' is LinkedIn's committee and work email rule, not your sales team's.
Names of 7 industries and 1 job title: the API returns ids only, and you didn't name them.
Audience size for the drafted targeting: no MCP action counts an audience; check the forecast in Campaign Manager before launch.
